title: A little team. A lot done.
layout:

title: Just say the word.
sub: A plan. A draft. A little more done.
layout:
ASK → RESULT — minimal conversation close-up, no outer phone. Pale warm lilac canvas #f3f0f7 with generous ivory negative space at top. Brand lockup upper left. Headline LEFT-ALIGNED on two lines: "Just say" charcoal, "the word." burnt peach. Subline exactly "A plan. A draft. A little more done.".
Create a premium editorial product composition with TWO intentional large cropped elements from reference image 2. First the actual violet user message bubble asking "Plan a relaxed weekend in Lisbon. I love good coffee, bookshops, and quiet places." floating at upper-right below the headline, sized very legibly. Below and slightly left, a larger white rounded result panel showing the exact assistant output from image 2: its introduction, the Search the web / Update files chips, bold "Your weekend, sorted.", Saturday/Sunday plan, and saved-files sentence. Use subtle layered shadows and a tiny warm orange curved path BETWEEN the fragments as editorial graphic. End with plenty of comfortable space; no giant repeating phone, no extra bots, no decorative fake notification.
